original_title: Harnessing Photoexcited-State Pathways in Boron Dipyrromethene for Phototheranostics and Photopolymerization
title: What else BODIPY's excited states can be talked into doing besides glowing
blurb: A spotlight piece on steering BODIPY dyes' photoexcited states away from plain fluorescence, toward triplet energy transfer for singlet-oxygen generation in phototherapy, or toward radical pathways for photopolymerization. Same scaffold, just pushed down a different excited-state pathway depending on the application.

original_title: Surface-Confined Steric Frustration Directs One-Dimensional BisNHC Assembly
title: Steric frustration herds carbenes into a one-dimensional lattice
blurb: A bulky tert-butyl bisNHC sitting on a surface gets squeezed into an asymmetric NHC-adatom-NHC arrangement, and that asymmetry hands each unit a dipole. The dipole-dipole interactions are what line everything up into a 1D metal-organic lattice. Steric bulk doubling as a design handle for periodicity is the neat part.

original_title: One-Pot Michael Addition–Elimination Approach to 4-Carboranylcoumarin-Derived Luminescent Systems
title: Swap the coumarin's bromine for a carborane and you get room-temp phosphorescence
blurb: One-pot Michael addition-elimination turns 3-bromocoumarins into 4-carboranylcoumarins, and the 4-isomer is red-shifted from steric crowding by the carborane. Amino versions do aggregation-induced emission through rotatable excited-state dynamics, but the methoxy one is the real find: 0.7 μs room-temperature phosphorescence plus dual emission when you dump it in 99% water.

original_title: CSPC Wins China Trial Nod for New Cancer Antibody-Drug Conjugate - TipRanks
title: CSPC gets the green light to run an ADC trial in China
blurb: Chinese regulators cleared CSPC's new antibody-drug conjugate for cancer to start trials there. That's the whole update, no data yet.

original_title: Lock-in Biosensing beyond the Analog Ensemble Detection Limits
title: Getting digital-assay sensitivity without going single-molecule
blurb: Analog ensemble detection chokes on detector noise and nonspecific binding, and the usual fix, digital single-molecule assays, is a pain to translate clinically. This swaps endpoint binding into periodic optical fluctuations and reads them out with lock-in detection, amplifying the real signal over the noise without single-molecule hardware. If it holds up, that's a cheaper route to digital-assay sensitivity.

original_title: Emergence of open chemical reaction network thermodynamics within closed systems
title: Open reaction networks turn out to be closed ones that haven't relaxed yet
blurb: Open chemical reaction networks, the chemostat kind that trade species with an environment, are the standard way to model systems away from equilibrium, but real systems are closed and eventually settle. This shows open-CRN behavior just falls out as an asymptotic regime of a closed CRN once two fairly minimal conditions hold. Tidies up a conceptual gap rather than reporting anything synthesized.

original_title: Non‐metal Lewis Acid‐Catalyzed Reduction of Phosphine Oxides with Silanes: Mechanistic Study and Reaction Optimization
title: Figuring out how silanes actually reduce phosphine oxides
blurb: Non-metal Lewis acid catalyzed reductions of phosphine oxides to phosphines work fine, but nobody had nailed down why. Combined computation and experiment turn up two distinct pathways, a push-pull mechanism and a silane-activation mechanism, and that insight gets used to improve the standard Bronsted acid catalyzed version.

original_title: Layered Spin‐Crossover Metal‐Organic Frameworks for Light‐Induced Control of Two‐Dimensional Quantum Materials
title: A spin-crossover MOF as a light switch for 2D quantum materials
blurb: They wire a layered Hofmann-type spin-crossover MOF into electrical nanodevices with a 2D quantum material and use the MOF's switchable spin state to dial the material's electronic transport. MOFs usually get stuck doing gas separation and catalysis duty, so using one as a stimuli-responsive building block inside a working device is the actual move here.

original_title: One-Pot Tandem Annulation of N -(2-Alkynylaryl)- N -sulfonylcyanamides with Water for the Synthesis of 2-Amino-3-carbonylindoles
title: Water as the oxygen source for building amino-carbonylindoles
blurb: A metal-free one-pot annulation of N-(2-alkynylaryl)-N-sulfonylcyanamides with water builds 2-amino-3-carbonylindoles, passing through isolable N,O-BF2 intermediates that Et3N opens up. H2-18O labeling confirms water itself donates the carbonyl oxygen, and the protocol tolerates a range of sulfonamides, scales to grams, and deprotects afterward.

original_title: Mapping Ligand-Induced Conformational Changes during the Enzymatic Cycle of Human Geranylgeranyl Diphosphate Synthase
title: Watching GGDPS flex through its catalytic cycle
blurb: GGDPS stitches farnesyl diphosphate and isopentenyl pyrophosphate together into geranylgeranyl diphosphate, and its active site is flexible enough to juggle different ligands along the way. Substrate- and product-bound structures already existed, but apo and Mg2+-only snapshots were missing, which is the gap this maps.

original_title: Receptor Dimerization‐Engineering Hydrogel to On‐Demand Regulate Cellular Behaviors
title: A hydrogel that dials receptor dimerization up or down on command
blurb: REMEDY packs a dynamic bispecific aptamer into a triglycerol monostearate nanoparticle hydrogel, built via dual rolling circle amplification to deliver aptamers that force receptor tyrosine kinases to pair up. The point is on-demand control over a process that cells otherwise just do when they do it.

original_title: Polymethylsilsesquioxane Aerogel-like Xerogels via a Surfactant-Free Base-Catalyzed Process
title: Aerogel-grade insulation without the acid step or surfactant
blurb: One-step base-catalyzed synthesis from methyltrimethoxysilane in IPA/water skips the usual acid stage and surfactant entirely, and the dried material comes out with fewer residual silanols than the two-step reference. Scaled up 20-fold it still holds thermal conductivities around 0.018-0.021 W/m/K, so this isn't just a bench curiosity.

original_title: Nickel-Catalyzed Thiolative Cyclization of Cyclic Enynones under Visible-Light Irradiation: An Easy Access to 9-Sulfenyl-2,3-dihydrophenanthren-4(1 H )-ones
title: Light plus nickel turns enynones into sulfur-tagged phenanthrenones
blurb: Nickel-catalyzed hydrothiolation of cyclic enynones followed by visible-light-driven cyclization delivers 9-sulfenyl dihydrophenanthrenones in good to high yields, and it works with both aromatic and aliphatic thiols. They also push the products on to phenanthrene derivatives, so it's a usable route in, not just a one-off adduct.

original_title: Replacing anaerobic fermentation with reverse β-oxidation enables growth-coupled evolution for enhanced fatty-alcohol production
title: Swap E. coli's fermentation for one that makes fatty alcohols instead of ethanol
blurb: They replaced E. coli's native mixed-acid fermentation with a redox-balanced reverse beta-oxidation pathway that's bioenergetically equivalent to ethanol fermentation but produces medium-chain fatty alcohols instead. Because it still lets the cells grow anaerobically, fitness gets coupled directly to making the product, so adaptive evolution could just select for more of it. Evolved strains hit a fourfold productivity jump, 110 mg/L/hr. Coupling growth to the product you actually want is the clever part here.

original_title: Recent developments of fluorescent proteins and biosensors driven by cross-disciplinary insights
title: A roundup of where fluorescent protein engineering is heading
blurb: A review tracking recent fluorescent protein and biosensor engineering and how much of the progress is borrowed from other fields. Useful as a state-of-the-field reference, not a single new result.

original_title: Sub‐Second Ratiometric Fluorescence Imaging of Histamine Dynamics in Living Cells via a Supramolecular Probe
title: A histamine sensor fast enough to actually catch histamine moving
blurb: Standard fluorescent histamine probes are too slow and too touchy about their surroundings to track real intracellular dynamics. This one sidesteps that with a supramolecular trick: cucurbit[7]uril wraps cationic fluorophores into a 2:1 complex, and histamine displacing the guest triggers a 60 nm shift read out ratiometrically in under a second.

original_title: Bacterial Surfaces and Barriers: Biogenesis and Pathogen–Host Interactions
title: Mapping the bacterial surface, from lipids to virulence
blurb: A review stitching together lipid diversity, membrane protein biogenesis, and lipoprotein processing across the two major bacterial lineages, then connecting that structural bookkeeping to how pathogens remodel their surfaces to infect hosts. Reference material more than a result.

original_title: Discovery of C5-Substituted 2′-Fluorinated Pyrimidine Nucleosides as Potent and Orally Efficacious Anti-HSV Agents
title: A nucleoside anti-herpes lead that works as a pill
blurb: Phenotypic screening of a nucleoside library turned up C5-substituted 2'-fluoropyrimidine nucleosides as anti-HSV scaffolds, and the SAR showed five-membered heteroaryls at C5 boost potency while cytosine and alkynyl variants don't. The optimized lead, B10, hits HSV-1 with an EC50 of 0.6 and is reportedly orally efficacious, which is the part worth noting for a nucleoside analog.

original_title: Tryptoline stereoprobe elaboration identifies inhibitors of the GRPEL1–HSPA9 complex
title: Tweaking a stereoprobe far from its warhead rewrites which proteins it hits
blurb: Elaborating covalent tryptoline stereoprobes at sites distal to the reactive electrophile completely reshuffles their protein interaction landscape, turning up disruptors of the GRPEL1-HSPA9 complex and binding events that cofolding models missed entirely. Where you decorate a covalent probe apparently matters as much as the warhead itself.

original_title: Bioactive κ-Carrageenan/hyaluronic acid hydrogel sheet dressing with sustained bromelain release to promote healing of full-thickness burn injury.
title: A burn dressing that doses out bromelain over time
blurb: A kappa-carrageenan/hyaluronic acid hydrogel sheet built to release bromelain slowly into a full-thickness burn wound instead of dumping it all at once, aimed at steady enzymatic debridement while the wound heals.

original_title: Peptide chemistry help (TBAF deprotection)
title: Peptide chemistry help (TBAF deprotection)
blurb: Hi all, I am desperately needing help on my peptide synthesis project. I need to selectively deprotect a hydroxy group on my peptide. It is now a TBDPS silyl ether. TBAF is the most straightforward way to do this but I’m having issues with visualizing my LCMS. Not sure because of ion supression or what. Is there a subreddit for peptide chemistry? Any help is appreciated. Thanks!
